title: Remove unused company entity from default CRM
description: The company entity is not used in the Inmovel domain (leads are persons, not companies). Remove all company routes, list/show/edit components, navigation entries, TypeScript types, FakeRest data generators, and any reference to companies inside other components (contact inputs, dashboards, relation selectors, activity log, sidebar). The contacts table 'company_id' FK column becomes unused; remove it from the schema file and from the contacts_summary view.
acceptance_criteria: All files under src/components/atomic-crm/companies/ are deleted
src/components/atomic-crm/root/CRM.tsx no longer imports or registers a 'companies' Resource
src/components/atomic-crm/layout/ navigation components contain no company menu item
src/components/atomic-crm/types.ts removes the Company type and any company_id field from Contact
src/components/atomic-crm/providers/fakerest/dataGenerator/companies.ts is deleted and its import removed from index.ts
supabase/schemas/01_tables.sql removes the companies table definition and the company_id FK column from the contacts table
supabase/schemas/03_views.sql removes company-related joins and columns from contacts_summary
No TypeScript import referencing Company or companies remains in CRM application files

non_functional_requirements.performance: No regression on contact list render
non_functional_requirements.security: No orphan RLS policies referencing companies table
